PLUGIN.NAME: Memos
PLUGIN.DESCRIPTION: Imports Memos with checkboxes as tasks and syncs task notes with Memos.

CFG.FILTER_TAG_HELP: Without #, e.g. "work". Empty: all memos with checkboxes.
CFG.FILTER_SPACE_HELP: e.g. "team" or "spaces/team". The Memos URL and access token are set in the plugin settings and the plugin menu.
CFG.INCLUDE_COMPLETED: Also offer memos whose checkboxes are all checked
CFG.TITLE_MODE_HELP: How the task title is built from the memo
CFG.TITLE_MODE_CASCADE: Smart: single open checkbox, else text before the first checkbox, else generic

MENU.SYNC_NOW: Memos: Sync all task notes now

TOKEN.DIALOG_TEXT_UNSET: Create an access token in Memos (Settings → My account → Access tokens) and paste it here. It is stored on this device only and is not synced.
TOKEN.DIALOG_TEXT_SET: A token is stored on this device. Paste a new one to replace it.
TOKEN.SAVED: Memos token saved on this device

SUBTASKS.DIALOG_TEXT: Selected checkboxes become subtasks. Completing a subtask checks the box in Memos and vice versa.
SUBTASKS.NONE_LEFT: This memo has no open checkboxes without a subtask
SUBTASKS.ONLY_MEMO_TASKS: Only available for tasks imported from Memos
SUBTASKS.CHECKBOX_GONE: Memos: The checkbox of this subtask no longer exists in the memo

SYNC.CONFLICT_COMMENT: Older version, replaced during a sync conflict with Super Productivity:
SYNC.CONFLICT_SNACK: Memos: notes of "{{title}}" changed on both sides. The older version is kept as a comment on the memo.
SYNC.DISABLED: Memos: note sync is turned off in the plugin settings

ERRORS.NO_BASE_URL: Memos: please set the Memos URL in the plugin settings
ERRORS.BLOCKED_HOST: Memos: Super Productivity blocks private IP addresses and localhost for plugins. Please use a host name in the Memos URL (e.g. https://memos.home.lan).
ERRORS.AUTH: Memos: access denied. Please check the access token (plugin menu "Memos: Set access token").
